error.interval_required: Un intervalle en km ou en mois doit être défini.

update_odometer.name: Update odometer
update_odometer.description: Updates a vehicle's odometer. Without a date, updates the current odometer; with a date, records or edits the history point for that date.

date.name: Date
date.description: Reading date (YYYY-MM-DD). Optional — defaults to today.

update_registration.name: Update registration
update_registration.description: Updates the registration (registration card) of a vehicle.

update_purchase_date.name: Update purchase date
update_purchase_date.description: Updates the purchase date (service start) of a vehicle.

update_brand_model.name: Update brand and model
update_brand_model.description: Updates the brand, model and optionally the photo, registration and purchase date of a vehicle.

add_maintenance_done.name: Add a logbook entry
add_maintenance_done.description: Adds a completed maintenance to the vehicle's maintenance logbook. If plan_id is provided, the associated maintenance plan is reset.

km.name: Odometer
km.description: Odometer at the time of the maintenance.

actions.name: Natures
actions.description: Maintenance nature(s) — a string or a list of strings.

invoice_path.name: Invoice (URL)
invoice_path.description: Path or URL of an existing invoice (optional).

invoice_base64.name: Invoice (base64)
invoice_base64.description: Invoice photo or PDF encoded in base64 (optional).

plan_id.name: Maintenance plan
plan_id.description: Plan to reset (optional, name matching is automatic).

add_maintenance_plan.name: Add a maintenance plan
add_maintenance_plan.description: Adds a periodic maintenance rule (at least one interval required).

interval_km.name: Interval (km)
interval_km.description: Frequency in kilometers (optional if months set).

interval_months.name: Interval (months)
interval_months.description: Frequency in months (optional if km set).

last_date.name: Last date
last_date.description: Date of the last completion (YYYY-MM-DD, optional).

update_maintenance.name: Edit a logbook entry
update_maintenance.description: Edits an entry of the vehicle's maintenance logbook (date, odometer, natures, cost, invoice).

index.name: Index
index.description: Index of the entry in the logbook (0 = most recent).

km.name: Odometer
km.description: Odometer at the time of the maintenance.

actions.name: Natures
actions.description: Maintenance nature(s) — a string or a list of strings.

invoice_base64.name: Invoice (base64)
invoice_base64.description: Invoice photo or PDF encoded in base64 (optional).

delete_maintenance.name: Delete a logbook entry
delete_maintenance.description: Deletes an entry of the vehicle's maintenance logbook.

index.name: Index
index.description: Index of the entry in the logbook (0 = most recent).

delete_odometer_point.name: Delete an odometer reading
delete_odometer_point.description: Deletes the odometer history point for the given date. If it was the latest reading, the current odometer falls back to the maximum of the remaining readings.

date.name: Date
date.description: Date of the reading to delete (YYYY-MM-DD).
